probe.description: A probe run against the current code that shows the feature is absent.

command.description: The exact command, run in the scratch copy.

output.description: An excerpt of its output (a few lines).

fails.description: true when the probe failed as expected (the feature is absent); false means the feature may already exist: say so in notes.

path.description: The probe file inside the scratch copy, when it is a file.

specs.description: Numbered specs the implementation must meet, quoting the request's exact strings.

check.description: The command or observable outcome that proves it.

docsScope.description: The docs to change (paths), or none and why.

backcompat.description: What existing callers, flags, config, or formats notice; none and why when nothing.

fit.description: How it fits the project's architecture: the existing module or pattern it extends.

notes.description: Open questions for the user, assumptions, out-of-scope parts.
